c74object.name: bachmcp.server
c74object.description: Starts and stops the bach-mcp server: a local model (local) or Claude (claude). One per patch, except one local and one claude together. Every instance in Max (bachmcp.generator, bachmcp.transformer, bachmcp.selector, bachmcp.algorithm, bachmcp.score, bachmcp.algorithm~) talks to it. The attributes are written to bachmcp.toml when the object is created; one left out keeps the value the file has.

inlet.digest: start, stop, map_refresh, open, debug, verbose, get_active_instance, set_skills, set_profile, install, model_catalog, download

outlet.digest: To bach.roll: writetxt, when a tool asks for the score
Each answer (instance, tokens, time, answer) and each prompt's stage (instance, status, profile, skills, skills_size), as a dictionary
Dumpout: the output of the server and the installer, the active instance

objarg.name: host
objarg.description: local: a model running on this computer (main.py run). claude: prompts answered by Claude Code on your account, the tools served over MCP (main.py serve).

method.name: map_refresh
method.description: Asks every bachmcp instance in Max for its name and type, and sends the map to the server again.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the chat page in the browser.

method.name: debug
method.description: 1 prints every line from Python in the Max console.

method.name: verbose
method.description: 1: prints in the Max console each stage of every prompt (received, queued, thinking, calling a tool, done...). The same as verbose.

method.name: get_active_instance
method.description: Sends the name of the active instance out of the dumpout outlet.

method.name: set_skills
method.description: The skill files (in playground/skills/, without .md) read after the profile's, by every instance whose skills is global. none: no extra skills. Applied at the next prompt. The same as skills.

method.name: set_profile
method.description: A profile in playground/skills/profiles/ (without .json), read by every instance whose profile is global. Applied at the next prompt. The same as profile.

method.name: install
method.description: Makes the virtual environment and sets everything up: install for both hosts, install local or install claude for one. Follow it in the Max console. Running it again repairs or adds what is missing.

method.name: model_catalog
method.description: Prints the models listed in models/catalog.toml.

method.name: download
method.description: Downloads a model into models/: a catalog name, a Hugging Face repo, a Hugging Face link, or a direct link to a file.

attribute.name: active
attribute.description: 1: the server starts by itself once the patch has loaded. 0 (default): it waits for start.

attribute.name: listen_port
attribute.digest: Port the server sends to Max
attribute.description: UDP port Max listens on ([max] send_port).

attribute.name: prompt_port
attribute.digest: Port Max sends to the server
attribute.description: UDP port the server listens on ([max] receive_port). One server at a time can hold it.

attribute.name: url
attribute.description: The chat page and /mcp are served here.

attribute.name: url_port
attribute.description: The port of the chat page and /mcp.

attribute.name: playground
attribute.digest: Folder for everything the model makes
attribute.description: Algorithms, scores, gen~ code, skills and conversations are kept here. Default: playground/ in the package.

attribute.name: model
attribute.description: local: a folder name in models/, a path, or a Hugging Face repo. claude: opus, sonnet, haiku or fable. Left out: the one in bachmcp.toml.

attribute.name: effort
attribute.description: claude only: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. More thinking: slower, more tokens.

attribute.name: claude_code_prompt
attribute.description: claude only. true: Claude Code's system prompt with the skill added to it. false: the skill alone, as the local model reads it (about 2,300 fewer tokens per request).

attribute.name: profile
attribute.description: A profile in playground/skills/profiles/ (without .json): the list of skills new conversations read. Instances with their own profile read theirs.

attribute.name: skills
attribute.description: Skill files in playground/skills/ (without .md), read after the profile's. none (default): none.

attribute.name: verbose
attribute.description: 1: prints in the Max console each stage of every prompt.

attribute.name: context_size
attribute.description: local, GGUF models: tokens the model reserves memory for.

attribute.name: extra_args
attribute.digest: More flags for the model server
attribute.description: local: passed as they are to the model server.

attribute.name: max_tokens
attribute.description: local: includes the thinking.

attribute.name: temperature
attribute.description: local: sampling temperature.

attribute.name: top_p
attribute.description: local: nucleus sampling.

attribute.name: top_k
attribute.description: local: top-k sampling.

attribute.name: presence_penalty
attribute.description: local: 0 is off.

attribute.name: reasoning
attribute.description: local: on or off.

attribute.name: skill_file
attribute.description: Empty: the built-in skill.

attribute.name: max_tool_rounds
attribute.description: local: rounds of tool calls the model may chain in one answer.

attribute.name: docs
attribute.description: Adds the instrument docs to each message that names an instrument.

attribute.name: open_browser
attribute.description: Opens the chat page when the model is ready (1/0 also work).

attribute.name: tool_log
attribute.description: Prints each tool call in the console.
